description: A private link to the person's progress page: their sites, every read, what each changed, and what this agent has asked. Signed with this key; it lapses after the days asked (30 if none, 90 at most) or when the key is rotated. Hand it only to the person.

days.description: How many days the link lasts, from 1 to 90.

name: mttr_progress_link
title: Make a progress link
